<translate>
<!--T:1-->
Every race in DragonMineZ has a '''racial skill''': a set of signature passives and, for some races, abilities you trigger yourself. The race-selection screen and the '''Skills''' menu always show your server's live values, with each part of the racial skill listed as its own entry; the numbers on this wiki are the defaults. Each race page explains its racial skill in full.
</translate>

<translate>
== Using an active racial skill == <!--T:19-->
</translate>
{{See also|Controls|Menus}}
<translate>
<!--T:20-->
# Hold '''X''' to open the utility menu and select '''Racial Skill''' in the '''Actions''' slice.
# Hold or press the '''action key''' ('''G''' by default). What it does depends on your race.

<!--T:21-->
'''Alt + G''' triggers the racial skill's secondary action while a racial skill is selected, such as dismissing your Cell Jrs. as a Bio-Android.

<!--T:22-->
While Namekian '''Assimilation''' or Majin '''Absorption''' is the selected action, your '''finishing blows knock enemies down instead of killing them''', so you can absorb them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Racial progress == <!--T:23-->

<!--T:24-->
Some racial skills build up progress that stays with you until you lose it or reset it:

<!--T:25-->
* '''Zenkai''' (Saiyan): up to 3 permanent boosts to STR, SKP and PWR, each raising your Power Release limit through Limitless Power.
* '''Assimilation''' (Namekian): up to 4 assimilations; you lose the latest one when you die.
* '''Absorption''' (Majin): up to 3 absorptions; you lose all of them when you die.
* '''Cell Jr.''' (Bio-Android): up to 3 summoned Cell Jrs. at a time.
</translate>

<translate>
== Resetting racial progress == <!--T:26-->

<!--T:27-->
The permanent racial gains (Zenkai boosts and the Power Release bonus, assimilations, absorptions and Cell Jrs.) can be reset:

<!--T:28-->
* '''Wish:''' the '''Reset Passive''' wish, available from both [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]].
* '''Command:''' <code>/dmzracial reset [targets]</code>, with the permission nodes <code>dmzracial.reset.self</code> and <code>dmzracial.reset.others</code> (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Commands|Commands]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Permissions|Permissions]]). It also clears racial cooldowns and despawns your Cell Jrs.

<!--T:29-->
After a reset you can earn them again from zero.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration == <!--T:30-->
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|racialSkills}}
<translate>
<!--T:31-->
All racial tuning lives in <code>config/dragonminez/general-server.json</code> under <code>racialSkills</code>. A master switch, <code>enableRacialSkills</code>, turns every racial skill on or off, and each race has its own section (<code>human</code>, <code>saiyan</code>, <code>namekian</code>, <code>frostdemon</code>, <code>bioandroid</code>, <code>majin</code>, <code>glind</code>) with its own <code>enabled</code> switch and values. Which section a race uses is set by <code>racialSkill</code> in its <code>races/&lt;race&gt;/character.json</code>. Reload the config with <code>/dmzreload config</code>.

<!--T:32-->
Config files from before v2.2 that still use the old flat keys (such as <code>saiyanZenkaiAmount</code>, <code>namekianAssimilationAmount</code> or <code>majinAbsorptionAmount</code>) are moved into the per-race sections automatically the first time v2.2 loads the file. The old Majin Revive and Human Ki regeneration keys are removed.
</translate>
{{See also|General Server Config|Custom Races|Reloading and Updating Changes}}
